_meta.purpose: Real-query eval set for retrieval-quality validation (real-retrieval-validation cycle).
_meta.format: q = natural-language question a real agent/user asks; expect = substring matched against retrieved card path/title; calloutCard = whether the expected card carries a callout (Metric B); why = 1-line rationale the expected card is the right hit.
_meta.queryStyle: Paraphrased the way a person asks — NOT the card title. Tests semantic+lexical+graph retrieval, not title substring match.
_meta.seeded: calloutCard:true cards were seeded this cycle (scripts/real-callout-seed.knowledge.jsonl). calloutCard:false are pre-existing prose cards.
_meta.phaseA_expansion: 2026-07-12: expanded 25->50 (SAG-inspired Phase A). New 25 span LTX levers, review patterns, infra lanes, CLI/pi gotchas, FP discrimination. Tests multi-hop (positive-sounding query -> AVOID card; X-pairs-with-Y) and paraphrase.
